chunks: Man is made of inordinate haste. We will show you Our signs, then you will not desire to hasten (the punishment).

key_terms.تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ: You hasten, specifically referring to desiring or rushing for the punishment
key_terms.عَجَلٍ: Haste, quickness, or inordinate speed in desire or action

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by man being created of haste?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the inherent impatience (bulm) of humanity, often interpreted as a desire for immediate divine retribution or blessings, contrasting with God's measured timing. It serves as a divine reassurance that the promised signs (ayat) will manifest inevitably, silencing those who rush to demand proof. This reflects the theological balance between human free will and divine wisdom in the timing of revelation and judgment.
